pre_condition: data is a dict whose keys are a subset of {"type", "replace_cmd", "input_md", "output_process"}. When the key "type" is present, its value is a string. When the keys "replace_cmd", "input_md", or "output_process" are present, each associated value is a string or None.
post_condition: Returns a PluginStageConfig instance such that: the 'type' attribute equals the value of the key "type" in data, defaulting to the empty string "" if the key is absent; the 'replace_cmd' attribute equals the value of the key "replace_cmd" in data, defaulting to None if the key is absent; the 'input_md' attribute equals the value of the key "input_md" in data, defaulting to None if the key is absent; the 'output_process' attribute equals the value of the key "output_process" in data, defaulting to None if the key is absent. No validation of field values (e.g., type must be "pass", "replace", or "modify") is performed by this function — the returned instance may contain arbitrary values for all fields.
